import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

# Test case for requirement U04_2: Patient generates a consultation request and doctor sees that request and gives the diagnosis
def test_patient_consultation_request_handling():
    patient = MagicMock()
    doctor = MagicMock()
    patient.generate_request = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    doctor.see_request = doctor.update_diagnosis = doctor.give_diagnosis = True
    doctor.give_diagnosis.return_value = "Diagnosis for condition"
    doctor.see_request.assert_called_once_with(patient.generate_request)

# Test case for requirement U04_3: Prescription generated by doctor is sent to patient, chemist, and labs
def test_prescription_distribution():
    patient = MagicMock()
    chemist = MagicMock()
    lab = MagicMock()
    doctor = MagicMock()
    doctor.generate_prescription = MagicMock(return_value="Prescription details")
    doctor.send_prescription_to = chemist.send_prescription_to = lab.collect_specimen_from = lab.update_report = True
    doctor.generate_prescription.assert_called_once_with()
    chemist.send_prescription_to.assert_called_once_with(patient)
    lab.collect_specimen_from.assert_called_once_with()
    lab.update_report.assert_called_once_with("Lab report details")

# Test case for requirement U04_4: Chemist uses prescription to deliver medicine to patient
def test_chemist_medicine_delivery():
    chemist = MagicMock()
    patient = MagicMock()
    chemist.deliver_medicine = chemist.send_prescription_to.return_value = True
    chemist.deliver_medicine.assert_called_once_with(patient)

# Test case for requirement U04_5: Labs use prescription to collect specimen and deliver lab report to patient
def test_lab_specimen_collection_and_reporting():
    lab = MagicMock()
    patient = MagicMock()
    lab.collect_specimen_from = lab.update_report = True
    lab.collect_specimen_from.assert_called_once_with()
    lab.update_report.assert_called_once_with("Specimen collection details")
    patient.receive_report.assert_called_once_with()

# Test case for requirement U04_6: Admin sets up specialties
def test_admin_sets_up_specialties():
    admin = MagicMock()
    admin.setup_specialties = admin.add_doctors = admin.add_labs = admin.add_pharmacy = True
    admin.setup_specialties.assert_called_once_with()

# Test case for requirement U04_7: Admin adds doctors
def test_admin_adds_doctors():
    admin = MagicMock()
    admin.add_doctors = True
    admin.add_doctors.assert_called_once_with()

# Test case for requirement U04_8: Admin adds labs
def test_admin_adds_labs():
    admin = MagicMock()
    admin.add_labs = True
    admin.add_labs.assert_called_once_with()

# Test case for requirement U04_9: Admin edits doctors information
def test_admin_edits_doctor_info():
    admin = MagicMock()
    admin.edit_doctor_info = True
    admin.edit_doctor_info.assert_called_once_with()

# Test case for requirement U04_10: Admin edits doctor information (update/delete)
def test_admin_edits_doctor_info_update_delete():
    admin = MagicMock()
    admin.update_doctor_info = True
    admin.update_doctor_info.assert_called_once_with()
    admin.delete_doctor_info.assert_called_once_with()
